name: MTL Minted
tagline: Artists mint their creative identity on Solana and supporters receive badges or fractional tokens.
problem: Artists struggle to fund their work sustainably.
solution: Mint creator tokens, issue supporter badges and fractional shares, and keep an on-chain history of support, positioned against speculation.
demo_moment: Team-described: support an artist and receive a badge.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Solana” among 127 submissions.

lessons: Address the obvious misuse of your tokens in the pitch.
